title: Collab: 'Start collaborating' doesn't update the host's browser URL to the room link
description:
USER REPORT: Clicking "Start collaborating" (host starting a session) does NOT change the host's browser address bar. The user expects the Figma/Google-Docs model where the host's URL becomes the shareable room link on Start.

INVESTIGATED AT HEAD 9d062642cdad66caf44738f8cf957bbe0ca1c099 (code read; no product change made).

== CURRENT BEHAVIOR + ROOT CAUSE (confirmed) ==
The share link IS minted and IS surfaced — but ONLY inside the Share dialog with a Copy button; window.location is never updated.

Host START flow:
  - ShareDialog 'Start collaborating' button onClick -> onStart() -> start()
    (packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/ShareDialog.tsx:250-257, button at :374-382).
  - CollabContext.start() (packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/CollabContext.tsx:60-72)
    calls startCollab(documentStore, {...}) and setSession(s). No location write.
  - startCollab() (packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/collabSession.ts:205-244) mints the
    link via generateCollabLink() (link = options.link ?? generateCollabLink(), :209),
    builds the y-webrtc provider, attaches the binding, returns the session.
  - The link is minted in collabLink.ts generateCollabLink() (:73-78): #room=<16B>&k=<32B>,
    base64url, both secrets in the URL FRAGMENT (k = the E2E capability).

Where the link reaches the user (dialog ONLY):
  - ShareDialog computes shareUrl via session.shareUrl(window.location.origin +
    window.location.pathname) (ShareDialog.tsx:241-248) and shows it in a read-only input
    (data-testid collab-share-link, :304-317) with a Copy button (onCopy -> navigator.
    clipboard.writeText, :273-283 / :318-325).

ABSENCE of any address-bar update — confirmed by grep over packages/authoring-ui/src
(excluding tests):
  - No history.pushState / history.replaceState / location.hash= / location.href= /
    window.location= anywhere in the collab path. The ONLY window.location use in collab is
    a READ at ShareDialog.tsx:245 (origin+pathname) to BUILD the share-link string.
    (store/history.ts pushState is the undo/redo reducer, not browser history.)
  - The session exposes session.fragment() (collabLink '#room=...&k=...', collabSession.ts
    :99/:184) and session.shareUrl(base) — neither is ever written to the address bar.
  => The host obtains the link only via the dialog Copy button, NOT the address bar.

Coupling baseline (confirmed): parseCollabLink is invoked ONLY in ShareDialog.onJoin
(ShareDialog.tsx:261); nothing reads location.hash at mount; COLLAB_ENABLED_DEFAULT=false
(store/collabFlag.ts) — i.e. NO auto-join-on-load, by deliberate design.

== EXPECTED UX (Figma / Google Docs) ==
On Start, the host's URL becomes the room link (so it can be copied straight from the
address bar; the URL reflects session state). This is the user's expectation.

== RECOMMENDED FIX (decision required — note the coupling) ==
The naive 'just write the fragment to the URL on Start' has a real coupling with the
deliberate no-auto-join-on-load security design:
  - If Start writes #room&k to the host URL, then on REFRESH the host sees the room link
    in the address bar but is NOT auto-rejoined (auto-join is intentionally absent). The
    URL would be MISLEADING: it shows a session the host is no longer in.

So a clean fix needs ONE of:
  (a) Update the URL on Start (history.replaceState/pushState with session.fragment())
      AND wire a consent-gated rejoin-on-refresh: on load, if location.hash parses as a
      collab link, offer to (re)enter the room. Ideally the HOST re-entering their OWN
      freshly-created room does not need a fresh consent prompt (vs a cold invite link
      from someone else, which should still prompt). Clear the fragment on Leave so a
      stale link never lingers. This preserves the no-silent-auto-join guarantee while
      making the address bar truthful.
  (b) Deliberately KEEP the URL clean and rely on the dialog Copy button (current
      behavior) — i.e. document this as an intentional choice and (optionally) make the
      dialog's link affordance more prominent. Lower effort; diverges from Figma/Docs.

SECRET-IN-ADDRESS-BAR NOTE: the link IS the capability (k = the E2E key, full edit
access). Writing it into the host's address bar has a minor shoulder-surf / browser-
history-leak consideration (it lands in autocomplete/history, screenshots, screen-share).
Whoever implements (a) should weigh this — fragments aren't sent to servers, but they DO
persist in local history; consider not persisting in history (replaceState vs pushState)
and clearing on Leave.

PRIORITY: low-medium — a UX-expectation gap on an off-by-default (COLLAB_ENABLED_DEFAULT=
false) feature, not a correctness/security defect.

No duplicate exists (searched .tasks for url/address/location/hash/refresh/rejoin/auto-join
and the P0-P5 collab task set).
